name: Pingualuit National Park
policyReason: Nunavik Parks rules allow dogs only on a leash and only at places marked for that purpose; the park pages name no such places.
summary: Dogs only on a leash and only at places marked for them.

excerpts.quote: to travel or stay in a park or to engage in an activity in the park with a dog kept at all times on a leash and only at the places marked for that purpose;

dogRules.text: Dogs leashed at all times, only at places marked for dogs.
Guide dogs and dogs used in an activity offered in the park are allowed.
Control pets at all times, or leave them at home.
